prompt:
Create a high-fidelity desktop homepage composition for Josh King, a product designer. Render only the actual edge-to-edge web page canvas at roughly 1536×1024 landscape—no browser chrome, device, desk, presentation board, mockup frame, or surrounding environment.

This is option 2 of a canvas-first design study: "Vertical reading order." Use a pure near-black (#080909) field and build the experience only from typography, empty space, alignment, and one restrained active mark. No imagery of any kind.

Create an unusual but highly legible typographic arrangement. Along the far left, set "JOSH" above "KING" as a tall stacked typographic signature, reading normally—not letter-by-letter and not inside a container. Montserrat uppercase, warm white (#F2F0E9), large but narrow enough to leave an expansive central field. In the center-right, place "PRODUCT" and "DESIGNER" on two widely separated horizontal baselines, with PRODUCT smaller and DESIGNER much larger; let the asymmetry create tension without becoming chaotic. Place "DESIGN · CODE · AI" in small DM Sans near the midpoint. At the far right, arrange the navigation vertically as simple text only: WORK, LAB, ABOUT, CONTACT, with WORK in mint (#A7E0C3) and all others muted warm gray. Near the lower center, place "VIEW LATEST WORK" with a minimal mint dot directly after WORK. Near the bottom-left edge, a tiny "01" may appear as a quiet index.

No visible columns, rails, borders, boxes, cards, or panels—the structure must be inferred entirely through placement and whitespace. Font families are Montserrat for display and DM Sans for supporting text. Flat colors only: near-black, warm white, muted gray, and mint only for active state. Crisp, premium, refined, slightly unexpected, confident product-design portfolio.

STRICTLY EXCLUDE: photos, screenshots, UI thumbnails, client names, company logos, icons, illustrations, objects, symbols used as metaphors, narrative scenes, textures, noise, gradients, glow, glassmorphism, shadows, rounded rectangles, bento grids, side borders, eyebrow headings, serif fonts, invented awards or claims. Do not include "41 Realty", "The Viv", "Reserve", "StormForge", or any other client brand. Only use this visible copy: JOSH; KING; PRODUCT; DESIGNER; DESIGN · CODE · AI; VIEW LATEST WORK; WORK; LAB; ABOUT; CONTACT; 01.
